sources: https://www.cityofalmawi.gov/departments/parks-recreation/ (City of Alma Parks & Recreation page, read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): 'Located north of the City on Hwy 35, Rieck's Lake Park and Campground offers a playground and picnic area to the north with full restroom facilities (including quarter operated showers, 5min. for $1), two shelters and an enclosed shelter, and 20 campsites with 20 & 30amp 120v electricity (no water). Camping cost is $20/night and registration is required at the self-service booth onsite. The campground operates on a first come, first served basis. The campground is open from April 15 - October 15.'; City Hall (608) 685-3330.

https://www.cityofalmawi.gov/wp-content/uploads/Riecks-Park-Campground-Brochure.pdf (city brochure, downloaded through the headless browser 2026-11-20): 'Camping Rate: $20.00 per night'; 'Each site is paved and equipped with electric hookup, garbage receptacle, picnic table, stationary grill and fire ring'; map of sites 1-20 in a row between WI-35 and Rieck's Lake, north arrow to the left; legend potable water, showers, registration station, viewing area, boat ramp; 'Dump station located 1 mile north on Highway 35 at Walker's Silvermoon, behind establishment'; 'Camping facilities with 20 & 30amp 120v electric hookup/Wi-Fi located at shelter area'; regulations: 14-day limit, 'No more than one recreation trailer, pickup truck camper, or motor home may occupy a campsite' (Ordinance 158).

Esri World Imagery (tools/sat.py, 2026-11-20, leaf-off) at 44.3535,-91.9309 (400 m), 44.3550,-91.9325 and 44.3533,-91.9305 (120 m): ~20 angled paved pull-in pads off a one-way lane on the WI-35 causeway strip, tables on mown grass with scattered trees, the open water of Rieck's Lake ~15-25 m beyond the pads past a narrow (~3-8 m) brush/reed fringe on the bank; WI-35 ~15-25 m behind the pads; observation deck and day-use lot at the north end.

note: City of Alma park on WI-35 (Great River Road) at Rieck's Lake, a tundra-swan stopover beside the Mississippi, with an observation deck. Paved pull-in sites in a row between the highway and the lake. Showers are coin-operated; Wi-Fi at the shelter area. The nearest dump station is 1 mi north on WI-35 behind Walker's Silvermoon. --Claude
